# Godot MCP Pro

> 187 AI-powered tools connecting Claude, Cursor, and AI assistants to the Godot 4 editor via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). $15 one-time purchase.

## What is Godot MCP Pro?

Godot MCP Pro is a premium MCP server that gives AI assistants real-time access to the Godot 4 editor through a WebSocket connection. The AI can create scenes, edit scripts, simulate player input, inspect running games, build 3D environments, set up physics, add particles, manage audio, and more — all from a single conversation. It is the most comprehensive MCP integration for Godot, with 187 tools across 26 categories compared to 13-32 in free alternatives.

## Architecture

```
AI Assistant <--stdio/MCP--> Node.js Server (TypeScript) <--WebSocket:6505--> Godot Editor Plugin (GDScript)
```

The Godot plugin runs a WebSocket server inside the editor. The MCP server connects to it and translates MCP tool calls into editor commands. All mutations go through Godot's UndoRedo system for safe, reversible operations.

## Key Features

- **187 tools across 26 categories** — the most comprehensive Godot MCP integration
- **Full Undo/Redo** — every AI mutation is reversible with Ctrl+Z
- **Signal management** — connect, disconnect, and inspect signals (exclusive)
- **Input simulation** — keyboard, mouse, InputActions, multi-event sequences
- **Runtime analysis** — 20 tools for live game inspection, property monitoring, UI detection
- **3D scene tools** — meshes, lighting, PBR materials, environments, cameras, GridMaps
- **AnimationTree** — state machines, transitions, blend trees, parameter control
- **Physics setup** — collision shapes, layers, raycasts, body configuration
- **Particles** — GPU 2D/3D with presets (fire, smoke, rain, snow, sparks)
- **Audio management** — buses, effects (reverb, delay, compressor), 2D/3D players
- **Navigation** — regions, mesh baking, pathfinding agents
- **Automated testing** — test scenarios, assertions, stress testing, UI verification
- **Code analysis** — unused resources, signal flow mapping, circular dependency detection
- **Smart type parsing** — Vector2, Color, NodePath strings auto-converted to Godot types
- **Production-grade connection** — WebSocket heartbeat, auto-reconnect, port auto-scanning

## 187 Tools across 26 Categories

- **Project (10)**: project info, filesystem tree, file/content search, project settings read/write, UID conversion, autoloads
- **Scene (10)**: scene tree, create/open/delete/save, play/stop, instancing, file content, @export overview
- **Node (17)**: add/delete/rename/duplicate/move, properties, signals, anchors, resources, groups, editor selection
- **Script (9)**: list/read/create/edit/validate scripts, attach to nodes, open scripts, close/reload script tabs (Godot 4.7+)
- **Editor (15)**: screenshots (editor + game + visual diff), GDScript execution, error/output log, signals inspector, reload, editor camera, dialog auto-dismiss, unsaved-state check and save_all
- **Input Simulation (5)**: keyboard, mouse click, mouse move, InputAction, multi-event sequences
- **Input Map (2)**: list and create/modify input actions
- **Runtime Analysis (20)**: game scene tree, runtime properties, frame capture/recording, property and signal monitoring, input recording/replay, UI element detection, button click by text, node waiting, navigation
- **Animation (6)**: create animations, add tracks, insert keyframes, inspect, remove
- **AnimationTree (9)**: state machines, transitions, blend trees, tree parameters, IK modifiers (Godot 4.6+)
- **TileMap (6)**: set/fill/query/clear cells, tile set info
- **3D Scene (7)**: mesh primitives + .glb/.gltf import, lighting presets, PBR materials, environment (sky/fog/SSAO/SSR), cameras, GridMap setup and inspection
- **Physics (6)**: collision shapes (auto-detect 2D/3D), physics layers, raycasts, body configuration, collision audit
- **Particles (5)**: GPU particles 2D/3D, material config, color gradients, presets (fire/smoke/rain/snow/sparks)
- **Navigation (5)**: navigation regions, mesh baking, pathfinding agents, layer management
- **Audio (6)**: audio bus layout, bus creation/config, effects, 2D/3D audio players, audio audit
- **Theme & UI (8)**: colors, constants, font sizes, StyleBoxFlat, theme inspection, Control layout, virtual joystick (Godot 4.7+)
- **Shader (6)**: create/read/edit shaders, assign materials, set/get uniforms
- **Resource (4)**: read/edit/create .tres resource files, resource previews
- **Batch & Refactoring (7)**: find by type, signal audit, batch property set, batch node creation, cross-scene changes, dependency graph
- **Testing & QA (6)**: automated test scenarios, property assertions, screen text verification, stress testing, game speed control, test reports
- **Code Analysis (6)**: unused resources, signal flow mapping, scene complexity, circular dependencies, script references, project statistics
- **Profiling (2)**: FPS, memory, draw calls, physics monitors
- **Export (4)**: export presets, export commands, patch PCK export, export info
- **Headless (3)**: run scenes/scripts in a separate headless Godot process, locate the Godot binary
- **Android (3)**: list adb devices, read Android presets, one-step deploy to device

## Guides & Tutorials (Godot 4)

All guides are tested on Godot 4.4+ and address common pain points where outdated Godot 3 information still dominates search results:

1. **Connect AI to Godot 4** (Beginner, 5 min) — Set up MCP Pro and let Claude/Cursor control your editor
2. **Build a 2D Game from Zero** (Beginner, 15 min) — Complete Reversi game in one AI conversation
3. **3D Character Controller** (Intermediate, 20 min) — CharacterBody3D + Mixamo animations + AnimationTree + SpringArm3D camera
4. **Godot 4 Signal Patterns** (Intermediate, 10 min) — New callable-based signals (Godot 3's string-based connect is deprecated)
5. **Automated Game Testing** (Intermediate, 10 min) — AI play-tests with input simulation + assertions, no test framework needed
6. **AnimationTree State Machines** (Advanced, 15 min) — State creation, transitions, blend trees, parameter wiring
7. **Physics & Collision Setup** (Intermediate, 10 min) — CharacterBody2D/3D (renamed from PhysicsBody), collision layers
8. **Particle Effects Cookbook** (Beginner, 5 min) — GPUParticles2D/3D (replaced CPUParticles), presets and gradients

## Requirements

- Godot 4.4+ (tested on 4.4, 4.5, 4.6 and 4.7; a few tools need 4.6+ or 4.7+)
- Node.js 18+
- Windows, macOS, or Linux
- Any MCP-compatible AI client (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code + Cline, Windsurf)

## Setup (5 minutes)

1. Copy `addons/godot_mcp/` into your Godot project
2. Enable plugin: Project > Project Settings > Plugins > Godot MCP Pro
3. Build MCP server: `cd server && npm install && npm run build`
4. Add to `.mcp.json`: `{"mcpServers": {"godot-mcp-pro": {"command": "node", "args": ["/path/to/server/build/index.js"]}}}`
